title: Beautiful ambience.. cute jars or amber volitive
text:
Beautiful ambience.. cute jars or amber volitive. The amber glass casts a beautiful glow in a room which looks stunning .. and it’s all powered by the flame of the votive glass… This set has a romantic and classic charm to it- its a perfect choice for a wedding, candlelit dinner or taking a bubble bath to a whole new level..!!

The 3 scents are pleasing and definitely can be enjoyed alone.. however, these complement each other nicely if lit altogether- there’s definitely a common thread allowing them to do so. I find the strongest throw is “Endless Summer..” however, it isn’t more then 5-7ft max.. being smaller in size this is to be expected. (see included pic’s to see size comparisons.) These are best used sitting closer to the user on a desk top, bathtub edge.. or in smaller spaces such as bathroom or office- if wanting to enjoy the aromatherapy at its strongest and not just the visual effects.

For a set of 3 at $13- this is a solid find.. each candle provides 5-7hr of continuous burn. These have beautiful aesthetic‘s that can step up in any occasion appropriately or, be gift worthy from start to finish these have all the attention to detail- including the hinged box provide to gift and/or store candles in.

Only issue experienced when using.. 2 of 3 candles had wick swallowed up by wax! It appears as if the heat dislodges the wick base as it burns low.. it wont be an issue if burned in x1 sitting. But, if planning to use over time- this may pose a problem.. it happened on both candles with 1/4 of the candle left. Something to consider with how you plan to burn. Hoping this info will help in your decision- stay safe!
